key_insight: A scalable NLP pipeline can identify both cannabis use status and reasons for use from EHR notes, with fine-tuned GatorTron best for status and an LLM best for reasons.
clinical_relevance: This could improve real-world research on cannabis use, symptom self-management, and outcomes in autoimmune rheumatic disease populations where structured EHR fields miss important detail.
method: Retrospective EHR study of ARD patients from 2015-2024
Keyword screening with fuzzy matching and 50-word context windows around cannabis mentions
Expert annotation of 886 status snippets and 1,027 reason-for-use snippets; model benchmarking with held-out validation
evidence_signal: The abstract reports evaluation using accuracy, F1, recall, and precision on held-out validation data, with the best status model being a fine-tuned GatorTron 345M.
watch_item: Performance depends on note quality and keyword-based retrieval, so under-documented or ambiguous cannabis mentions may still be missed or misclassified.
paper_title: Extracting patient reported cannabis use and reasons for use from electronic health records: a benchmarking study of large language models
